reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with the terrain in Provincia. With our new native sparse cellular automata (CA), ponds are now more efficient, and terrain modifications like digging and raising are seamlessly integrated into the flow map. Plus, activating a well no longer causes frame freezes! Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: New Water Mechanics Update in Provincia
steam.body: We are thrilled to announce updates to the water mechanics in Provincia! With the implementation of native sparse CA, water now interacts more efficiently with terrain changes. You can dig and raise terrain without experiencing frame freezes, and wells operate smoothly without disrupting the gameplay. For a deep dive into these changes, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
